sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Coimmunoprecipitation assay; trafficking function reported not influenced by the FLAG insertion.
sites.rationale: Python confirms residue 31 = L and residue 32 = Q, both within the large extracellular domain (28–251), 4 residues after signal-peptide cleavage and 220 residues from TM1. L1 reports the exact insertion; L2 (independent paper) replicates it and explicitly states no trafficking perturbation, satisfying surface_and_function. The junction is well within the unstructured N-terminal stretch of the mature ectodomain. FLAG tag inserted between Leu31 and Gln32 of full-length GABRA1 in HEK293 cells (QuikChange II mutagenesis); L2 confirms the same construct was used for coimmunoprecipitation and explicitly states it does not influence trafficking function.

sources.claim: The FLAG tag was inserted between Leu31 and Gln32 in the α1 subunit for coimmunoprecipitation experiments, which do not influence trafficking function.
Myc tag (EQKLISEEDL) was inserted between the fourth and fifth residue of the mature α1, β3, or γ2S cDNA ( 7 ).

literature_notes: L3 and L4 both report CFP insertion at Lys364–Asn365, explicitly described as the TM3–TM4 intracellular loop (canonical positions 335–421 per topology landmarks). These are not surface sites and are recorded in other_positions. L5 maps to the identical junction as L1/L2 (Leu31–Gln32) by computation; it is retained as a separate site entry because it is an independent ledger line with a different tag, but it does not add a new surface position. No ledger line supports any other extracellular insertion site for GABRA1.

literature_other_positions.note: CFP inserted between Lys364 and Asn365 in the TM3–TM4 intracellular loop of full-length GABRA1; topology landmarks place residues 335–421 in the intracellular compartment, so this is not a surface tag site.
Independent replication of CFP at Lys364–Asn365 in the TM3–TM4 intracellular loop; same intracellular classification as L3.
